<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ComputerRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostAccepted" name="Repair costs accepted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TakenHome" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="Computer Repair Service (CRS)" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BroughtIn" name="Brings in defective computer" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_ComputerBroughtIn"/>

  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="Computer Repair Service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ComputerBroughtIn" name="Defective computer brought in">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BroughtIn" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckToCalculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateCosts" name="Calculate repair costs">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CalculateToSend</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" name="Send repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CalculateToSend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_CustomerDecision" name="Customer decision" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCostsAccepted</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToTakenHome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_CostsAccepted" name="Costs accepted">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostsAccepted" messageRef="Message_CostAccepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_TakenHome" name="Computer taken home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToTakenHome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TakenHomeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_TakenHome" messageRef="Message_TakenHome"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Unrepaired" name="Computer returned unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TakenHomeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Repair" name="Perform repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AcceptedToRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="SubStart_Repair" name="Repair started">
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_StartToParSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>

      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Split repair activities" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_StartToParSplit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_ParSplitToHW</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_ParSplitToSW</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:parallelGateway>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_ParSplitToHW</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_HWToTestHW</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test hardware functionality">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_HWToTestHW</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_TestHWToParJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_ParSplitToSW</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_SWToTestSW</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test software functionality">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_SWToTestSW</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_TestSWToParJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Join repair activities" gatewayDirection="Converging">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_TestHWToParJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_TestSWToParJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_ParJoinToErrorMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:parallelGateway>

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorMerge" name="Repair step merge" gatewayDirection="Converging">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_ParJoinToErrorMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_RetryMergeToErrorMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_ErrorMergeToErrorCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorCheck" name="Error detected?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_ErrorMergeToErrorCheck</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_NoErrorToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_ErrorToRetryChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_NoErrorToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetryChoice" name="Select repair activity (arbitrary)" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_ErrorToRetryChoice</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_RetryChoiceToHW</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_RetryChoiceToSW</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_RetryHardware" name="Check and repair hardware (again)">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_RetryChoiceToHW</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_RetryHWToTest</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RetryTestHardware" name="Test hardware functionality (again)">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_RetryHWToTest</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_RetryTestHWToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_RetryConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software (again)">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_RetryChoiceToSW</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_RetrySWToTest</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RetryTestSoftware" name="Test software functionality (again)">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_RetrySWToTest</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_RetryTestSWToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetryMerge" name="Retry merge" gatewayDirection="Converging">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_RetryTestHWToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_RetryTestSWToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_RetryMergeToErrorMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_StartToParSplit" sourceRef="SubStart_Repair" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_ParSplitToHW" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_HWToTestHW" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_TestHWToParJoin" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_ParSplitToSW" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_SWToTestSW" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_TestSWToParJoin" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_ParJoinToErrorMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_ErrorMergeToErrorCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_NoErrorToEnd" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="SubEnd_RepairFinished"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_ErrorToRetryChoice" name="Error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="Gateway_RetryChoice"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_RetryChoiceToHW" sourceRef="Gateway_RetryChoice" targetRef="Task_RetryHardware"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_RetryHWToTest" sourceRef="Task_RetryHardware" targetRef="Task_RetryTestHardware"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_RetryTestHWToMerge" sourceRef="Task_RetryTestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RetryMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_RetryChoiceToSW" sourceRef="Gateway_RetryChoice" targetRef="Task_RetryConfigureSoftware"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_RetrySWToTest" sourceRef="Task_RetryConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_RetryTestSoftware"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_RetryTestSWToMerge" sourceRef="Task_RetryTestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RetryMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_RetryMergeToErrorMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_RetryMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Repaired" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BroughtToCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_ComputerBroughtIn" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToCalculate" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_CalculateCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CalculateToSend" sourceRef="Task_CalculateCosts" targetRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToDecision" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCostsAccepted" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_CostsAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToTakenHome" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_TakenHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakenHomeToEnd" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_TakenHome" targetRef="EndEvent_Unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptedToRepair" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_CostsAccepted" targetRef="SubProcess_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairToEnd" sourceRef="SubProcess_Repair" targetRef="EndEvent_Repaired"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ComputerRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer brought in"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostAccepted" name="Repair costs accepted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TakenHome" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="Computer Repair Service (CRS)" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BroughtIn" name="Defective computer brought in" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer" sourceRef="ManualTask_BringIn" targetRef="StartEvent_ComputerBroughtIn"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_CostCalc"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostAccepted" name="Repair costs accepted" messageRef="Message_CostAccepted" sourceRef="IntermediateThrow_CostsAccepted" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_CostsAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TakenHome" name="Computer taken home unrepaired" messageRef="Message_TakenHome" sourceRef="IntermediateThrow_TakenHome" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_TakenHome"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerNeedsRepair" name="Computer defective">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustStartToBringIn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_BringIn" name="Bring in defective computer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustStartToBringIn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustBringInToCostCalc</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_CostCalc" name="Repair cost calculation received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustBringInToCostCalc</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustCostCalcToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostCalc" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CostsAcceptable" name="Costs acceptable?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustCostCalcToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustAccept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustReject</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="IntermediateThrow_CostsAccepted" name="Costs accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustAccept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustAcceptedToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostsAcceptedThrow" messageRef="Message_CostAccepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerAccepted" name="Repair continues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustAcceptedToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_TakeHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired">

    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="IntermediateThrow_TakenHome" name="Computer taken home unrepaired">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustThrowToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_TakenHomeThrow" messageRef="Message_TakenHome"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerTakenHome" name="Customer leaves with computer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustThrowToEnd</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustStartToBringIn" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerNeedsRepair" targetRef="ManualTask_BringIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustBringInToCostCalc" sourceRef="ManualTask_BringIn" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_CostCalc"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustCostCalcToDecision" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_CostCalc" targetRef="Gateway_CostsAcceptable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustAccept" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CostsAcceptable" targetRef="IntermediateThrow_CostsAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustAcceptedToEnd" sourceRef="IntermediateThrow_CostsAccepted" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustReject" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CostsAcceptable" targetRef="ManualTask_TakeHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustTakeHomeToThrow" sourceRef="ManualTask_TakeHome" targetRef="IntermediateThrow_TakenHome"/>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCostsAccepted</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToTakenHome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_CostsAccepted" name="Repair costs accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCostsAccepted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AcceptedToRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostsAccepted" messageRef="Message_CostAccepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_TakenHome" name="Computer taken home unrepaired">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_TakenHome" messageRef="Message_TakenHome"/>

        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_ParSplitToSW</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_SWToTestSW</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test software functionality">

        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_TestSWToParJoin</bpmn:outgoing>

        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_RetryHWToTest</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_RetryTestHardware" name="Test hardware functionality (again)">
